source_title: Frigidaire FGHB2868 platform spec (Water Filter EPTWFU01)
filter_location_text: Frigidaire FGHB2868 French-door models use a PureSource Ultra II cartridge in the top-right fresh-food compartment.
replacement_steps_summary: Frigidaire guidance for EPTWFU01: remove the old filter, slide the new PureSource Ultra II cartridge in, push and twist until locked, flush several minutes, then reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Frigidaire recommends genuine PureSource Ultra II filters; EPTWFU01 is not interchangeable with ULTRAWF or WF3CB housings.
notes: Tier 1 Frigidaire/Electrolux bundle for FGHB2868PF — FGHB2868T platform specification lists Water Filter Type PureSource Ultra II (EPTWFU01).
